stem: This cover from a nineteenth-century periodical helps illustrate that the United States was beginning to change from —

options.label: A
options.text: a mostly rural society to a mostly urban one

options.label: B
options.text: a slave-owning society to one without slavery

options.label: C
options.text: a foreign policy of isolationism to one of interventionism

options.label: D
options.text: a direct democracy to a representative one

visual_elements: The Manufacturer and Builder periodical cover with detailed illustration of an urban scene and two men, one on each side, with the date 1878.
